author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Private retry helper adds an indirection without owning a distinct policy.
findings.consequence: Readers following normal delivery failure handling have to jump from #deliver to a one-call helper before reaching the actual retry behavior, while the helper is used only for that single path.
findings.evidence: #retryBatch only calls #requeueFront(batch) and #scheduleRetry(), and the inspected source shows its only direct use is the transient failure path in #deliver. The page-exit failure paths already call those same primitives directly, so this helper does not centralize a shared policy.
findings.recommendation: Inline the two statements at the #deliver failure site and remove #retryBatch, keeping #requeueFront and #scheduleRetry as the actual policy boundaries.
verification: Inspected app/lib/observability/browser.ts, app/lib/observability/events.ts, app/plugins/observability.client.ts, and test/unit/observability-browser.spec.ts with read-only commands.
Inspected current source, direct import, direct caller, generated API type boundary import, and packet-listed unit tests using read-only commands.
